en: Vintage monochrome postcard with a decorative frame and German text. At the top it reads "BERGSTADT BRAND." The main illustration shows two traditionally dressed miners in ceremonial mining uniforms, standing on either side of a large coat of arms. The shield bears crossed mining hammers above what looks like a beehive or mound surrounded by many small dots, likely symbolizing ore or industry. Floral embellishments surround the composition. At the bottom is a printed German poem in red type, ending with the greeting "Glück Auf" and two crossed-hammer symbols.
